items.name: Finset.prod_le_pow_card
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [inst : CommMonoid N] [inst_1 : PartialOrder N] [MulLeftMono N] (s : Finset ι)
  (f : ι → N) (n : N), (∀ x ∈ s, f x ≤ n) → s.prod f ≤ n ^ s.card

items.name: Finset.max_prod_le
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [inst : CommMonoid M] [inst_1 : LinearOrder M] [IsOrderedMonoid M] {f g : ι → M}
  {s : Finset ι}, max (s.prod f) (s.prod g) ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, max (f i) (g i)

items.name: Nat.choose_le_pow_div
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Semifield α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] (r n : ℕ),
  ↑(n.choose r) ≤ ↑n ^ r / ↑r.factorial
